author: SHIVA
description: Urban Indians significantly boost their spending on Saturdays and Sundays, with a 1.6 times higher expenditure compared to weekdays. author: TNN
description: Household goods demand held steady in Q1 despite price hikes, as companies navigated inflation. While price increases helped offset rising costs, the sector faces a potential challenge from weather volatility affecting agricultural output and demand. author: TNN
description: Indonesia is set to integrate with India's UPI, aiming to build its own digital ecosystem inspired by India's public infrastructure. author: BHARTI JAIN
description: A significant majority of NGOs registered under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010, are no longer active, with over 72% having their licenses cancelled or expired. This tightening of regulations aims to enhance accountability and transparency among these organizations.

author: TNN
description: OPEC+ has approved an additional 188,000 barrels per day production increase for August, aiming to boost global crude availability and ease price pressures, particularly for importing nations like India. While oil firms anticipate breaking even on petrol and diesel soon, cooking gas sales continue to incur losses.

author: SHIVA
description: A recent National Statistics Office survey reveals that childcare and household duties sideline nearly 69% of women in India's largest cities from the workforce, underscoring a persistent gender bias in caregiving responsibilities. author: TNN

description: An investigation into Ram Temple donations in Ayodhya has revealed a stark financial uplift among accused individuals, with some building homes and acquiring SUVs despite modest known incomes. Evidence suggests significant daily siphoning of funds, estimated at Rs 6 to Rs 8 lakh, particularly during the Maha Kumbh period.  Concerns were raised about the handling of precious metal donations and the lack of proper oversight.
title: Houses, SUVs, Rs 5-6L stolen daily: How lifestyles of Ram temple theft accused changed dramatically

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mohamed Salah has chosen Lionel Messi as his ideal “last dance” partner ahead of Egypt’s FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 clash with Argentina in Atlanta. The showdown marks their first World Cup meeting, with Messi leading Argentina’s title defence and Salah chasing an upset. Both icons face a potentially defining knockout battle for a quarter-final place.
title: Salah picks Messi over Ronaldo, Neymar and Kane for World Cup 'last dance'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has expressed readiness to work with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un to foster long-term, stable bilateral ties. This comes amid escalating regional tensions and Pyongyang's deepening military collaboration with Russia. Xi's message, in response to Kim's congratulatory note, highlighted the historical bond and commitment to strengthening their strategic partnership, underscoring China's crucial economic role for North Korea.
title: Xi says ready to work with Kim for 'long-term, sound and stable' China-North Korea ties

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Portugal's dramatic World Cup win over Croatia has sparked debate about Cristiano Ronaldo's starting role. Zlatan Ibrahimovic controversially stated that Portugal cannot win the 2026 World Cup with a 41-year-old Ronaldo leading the attack, suggesting his legendary status is overshadowing current form. Despite Ronaldo scoring, Gonçalo Ramos' late winner highlighted the team's potential, leaving many questioning the veteran's continued prominence.
title: 'Ego holding Portugal hostage': Zlatan launches brutal attack on Ronaldo

title: Trump delays $5m sexual abuse payout to Jean Carroll; latter senses conspiracy

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Trump has offered to help resolve the Ukraine conflict following separate calls with Russian President Putin and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy. While Russia claims battlefield advances, Ukraine disputes these assertions. Trump's envoys are set to continue mediation efforts ahead of the upcoming NATO summit, where the stalled peace talks and the ongoing war are expected to be key discussion points.
title: Trump offers to help end Ukraine war during 90-minute call with Putin, Zelenskyy

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ukrainian drones targeted an oil terminal in St. Petersburg and military sites near the Baltic coast overnight, escalating attacks on Russia's energy sector. Governor Alexander Beglov confirmed the Kirovsky district oil terminal was hit, with no casualties.  President Zelensky claimed responsibility, stating the strikes hit revenue-generating oil infrastructure and the naval base at Kronstadt.  These actions come amid deepening fuel shortages across Russia, with long queues reported at petrol stations.
title: Ukraine hits Russian oil terminal; smoke rises over St Petersburg facility - watch

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: France lead Paraguay in a FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 clash played in extreme heat at Philadelphia’s Lincoln Financial Field, with temperatures near 100°F (37.8°C) and heat index reaching 105–110°F (40.6–43.3°C). The extreme conditions, under an official heat warning, have turned the match into a severe physical test, with Kylian Mbappé’s penalty separating the sides.
title: France vs Paraguay becomes one of hottest World Cup matches ever

author: TNN
description: Following alleged toddler abuse at a Bengaluru daycare, the Karnataka Commission for Protection of Child Rights will mandate CCTV cameras with live parental access at all centers. This move aims to enhance safety and transparency. The investigation into the incident, which involved a nanny allegedly locking a child in a bathroom and another nanny accused of suspicious video recording, is ongoing.
title: B'luru daycare horror: Whistleblower held; panel seeks live streaming at centres

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: The Cleveland Browns’ star player, Shedeur Sanders, has found his name regularly in trade rumors after his impressive performance in the last season, sparking chaos about his future. Ahead of the new season, it seems the New York Jets and the Miami Dolphins have emerged as potential landing spots for him.
title: NFL Trade Rumor: Jets, Dolphins top landing spots for Browns' $4m rookie

author: TAMAGHNA BANERJEE
description: Mamata Banerjee has reassumed leadership of her party amidst an organizational crisis, accusing the BJP of engineering defections through intimidation. She declared her Kolkata residence the party's permanent office, asserting that supporters, not symbols or buildings, define Trinamool's identity. Banerjee vowed to fight political persecution and warned rebels against aligning with the BJP while claiming party affiliation.
title: After desertions, Mamata Banerjee formally takes over as TMC state chief

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, making his India debut, confidently advised senior partner Abhishek Sharma on pitch conditions during the second T20I against England.  Becoming India's youngest international debutant, Sooryavanshi impressed with a fearless 14 off 10 balls, including two sixes.  His historic entry and bold batting display captivated fans, showcasing remarkable composure on the international stage.
title: 'Samne jayegi ki piche maaru?': Abhishek and Sooryavanshi's on-field chat goes viral

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Alia Bhatt's exhilarating spy thriller 'Alpha' has made a sensational debut, amassing ₹24 crore in India and ₹37 crore globally by its second day. Co-starring Sharvari, the film showcases impressive box office growth and captivated audiences right from the start. Kareena Kapoor Khan has praised the film's celebration of 'girl power', as it successfully engages viewers with its electrifying storyline.
title: 'Alpha' box office day 2: Alia Bhatt's spy thriller crosses Rs 37 crore worldwide

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sanju Samson's omission from India's T20I against England, despite his World Cup heroics, has sparked debate. Head coach Gautam Gambhir, who previously lauded Samson as 'world-class,' was seen in a quiet conversation with the player before the match. Samson's recent low scores on the UK tour led to his replacement by debutant Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, highlighting the swift shifts in international cricket fortunes.
title: Gambhir's animated chat with Samson after Sooryavanshi's debut goes viral

author: DR. ARATI KULKARNI SRIVASTAVA
description: Controversial comments by Kansas City Chiefs placekicker Harrison Butker regarding women’s roles and other social issues had sparked widespread debate in 2024. While teammates like Patrick Mahomes expressed disagreement but acknowledged Butker as a person, Travis Kelce defended him as a good teammate, though not endorsing his views back then. Amidst this, a viral rumor suggests Butker was reportedly uninvited to Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift’s royal wedding. Despite most of the team receiving invitations from their star tight end.
title: Why Harrison Butker was reportedly not invited to Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift's wedding

author: KUMAR RAKESH
description: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla confirmed the report on corruption charges against Justice Yashwant Varma will be presented in the monsoon session, despite his resignation. The House will decide the next steps after the report's tabling, which could happen on the session's first day. Justice Varma faces allegations of financial irregularities following a fire incident at his Delhi residence last year.
title: Inquiry report against Justice Varma will be tabled this session: Om Birla
